title: JobProgressPayload
description: Payload for the ephemeral jobs.progress stream topic, conveying live progress updates and non-terminal execution status for background jobs. Coalesced per job_id on backpressure overflow.

status.description: Current non-terminal execution status of the job.

detail.description: Optional human-readable description of current step or progress detail.

error.description: Transient or non-fatal warning message, if any.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant of the progress update.
